description: Deploy a compiled contract to Avalanche and return its address, once the transaction has succeeded and there is code at that address. Pass the contract either as artifactPath (a file: one of the `artifacts` scaffold_app returned, or a Foundry/Hardhat JSON artifact) or as abi + bytecode — exactly one of the two; artifactPath means no bytecode has to be copied into the call. On the Fuji testnet (the default) no key is needed: when AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY is not set, the server signs with a temporary session test wallet that exists only in its memory, works on Fuji only, and is funded from the AvaKit faucet when it cannot pay. Mainnet (c-chain) needs all three of: your own key in AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY, confirm:true in this call AND AVAKIT_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 in the server's environment, which only the person running the server can set — without it a mainnet call is refused even with confirm:true. A deployment that reverts is returned as an error. The result says which wallet signed. To call the deployed contract — for example to mint — use write_contract, which may call a contract deployed here, on that chain, for as long as the server runs.

abi.description: With bytecode, instead of artifactPath: the JSON ABI, or signatures such as ["constructor(address owner)"].

args.description: Constructor arguments, in order. Pass large integers as decimal strings.

artifactPath.description: Path to the contract's artifact file, relative to the server's working directory: one of the `artifacts` scaffold_app returned (e.g. my-app/lib/nft-artifact.ts), or a Foundry/Hardhat JSON artifact with abi and bytecode. Must be inside the working directory.

bytecode.description: With abi, instead of artifactPath: the creation bytecode (0x-prefixed).

confirm.description: Required on mainnet (c-chain), together with AVAKIT_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 in the server environment. Not needed on Fuji.

name: deploy_contract
title: Deploy a contract
